replies.author: Joltz_
replies.body:
Here, make some burgers.
200grams of mince
1cup of breadcrumbs
Half an onion, finely chopped up
1 egg, medium size
 A teaspoon of paprika 
A sprinkle of salt and pepper

Preheat your oven 220 degrees fan forced
Mix all together in a bowl, use your hands, mix until you are able to shape a patty without it crumbling apart.
Make 2 patties, try to make both even size, and put it on a tray lined with foil and put it in the oven for 8 minutes after its done flip over and put it in for 8 more minutes. 

Put it in some buns with ketchup and fillings and ye.
